title: Impact kernel contract types
responsibility: Defines the versioned impact graph, request and affected-node result types.

outputs.name: kernelContract
outputs.description: The string constant 'impact-kernel/1' that identifies the version of the impact kernel contract; it is exported as kernelContract from src/core/execution-runtimes/kernelTypes.ts alongside the KernelGraph, ImpactInput, AffectedNode and ImpactOutput types, and src/lib/runtime.ts re-exports it. It is a fixed string literal: neither owned source file computes, parses or validates it, and the contract declares no operation that returns it.
